headline: Executive order on using project labor agreements for federal construction projects.
what_it_does: This order deals with the use of project labor agreements on construction projects paid for by the federal government. A project labor agreement is a contract made before work starts that sets wages, hours, and other job terms for workers on a project, usually negotiated with labor unions. The material provided does not say which projects are covered, what size triggers the rules, or what exceptions apply.

who_it_affects.group: Construction companies that bid on federal projects
who_it_affects.how: They may need to agree to a project labor agreement to work on certain federal construction jobs.
Their pay and job terms on covered projects may be set by a project labor agreement.
They may take part in negotiating the agreements used on federal construction projects.
They may have to consider or include project labor agreements when planning and contracting for building projects.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed February 4, 2022; specific start dates are not stated in the provided material.
